commits.edited_message:
* src/type1/t1parse.c (T1_Get_Private_Dict): Merge segment reading.

Fixes #1470 by avoiding the second re-scanning.
The merged dictionary keeps a trailing NUL, as the PFA loader does.

* src/type1/t1parse.c (T1_Get_Private_Dict): Fix the segment merging.

Concatenated binary segments keep the same trailing NUL as an ASCII
private dictionary.

* isrc/type1/t1parse.c (T1_Get_Private_Dict): Check the size.

Fixes https://issues.oss-fuzz.com/issues/568035737, also in #1470.
Reserve a terminating byte inside the bounds-checked allocation.

coupling: Each commit records the PFB ciphertext length once (base_len, with single_block marking that the length was saved) and then both sizes the private-dictionary buffer to that length plus one and counts one extra byte in private_len. A single commit is balanced: the allocation and private_len both become ciphertext_size+1, so t1_decrypt stays inside the block and the extra byte is a trailing PostScript NUL. A second commit does not restash the length. FT_QREALLOC to the same base_len+1 does not grow the block — the old-size argument is ignored — but private_len is still incremented, so the decrypt writes past the heap allocation. Any pair is enough. Reverting any one edited diff leaves the other two increments against a one-byte allocation, so the overflow stays reachable; fixing it requires matching the absolute allocation to the summed length across every site.
